tenant_id.description: Must equal the tenant of the validated context; it names the tenant, it does not establish it.

context_id.description: The Control Plane PlatformContext that carries the tenant authority of this request. It is not a bearer credential: ERP validates it for the actual caller through Control Plane and uses only the tenant returned. It is authorisation evidence, not part of the request's identity, so it is excluded from idempotent replay. It is independent of control_plane_authority: a valid context never replaces the plan tuple, nor the tuple a context. Provisioning acts for a tenant that is not yet ACTIVE, so it must be a TENANT_PROVISIONING context (control-plane/v1 ContextAuthorityPurpose) whose provisioning_authority equals control_plane_authority; a RUNTIME context is refused.

control_plane_authority.description: The exact Control Plane plan that authorises this request (ADR-BCP-021: an approval binds the plan id, version and digest together). ERP reads Control Plane's ERP assignment for each legal entity and compares: the tenant, the provisioning, this exact plan id, version and digest, and the legal entity must all agree, otherwise ERP answers 409 PLAN_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH and provisions nothing. Naming only the provisioning would let a replan between approval and execution change what ERP executes. Approval records are Control Plane's: ERP does not interpret them and the request carries no approval id. The countries and currencies below are requested intent, never authority: ERP provisions what the approved plan and the Finance baseline say and refuses a mismatch.

finance_baselines.description: For each legal entity, the exact Finance baseline version the provisioning relies on: exactly one reference per entry of legal_entity_ids, no more and no fewer (a reference is obtained from ERP: getEffectiveFinanceBaseline names the version in force and getFinanceBaseline resolves one exactly). ERP re-resolves every reference against its authoritative store and answers 409 FINANCE_BASELINE_MISMATCH when the baseline, version, digest or legal entity is not what ERP holds, the baseline is not owned by ERP, or the legal entity is not one of the context's tenant, and 409 FINANCE_BASELINE_NOT_USABLE when the exact version is not EFFECTIVE (withdrawn, superseded or not yet effective). functional_currencies must then be exactly the set of the referenced baselines' functional currencies, otherwise 409 PLAN_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH. The request never carries accounting configuration and Control Plane never derives it. Nothing is provisioned on any refusal.

deployment_policy_id.description: Opaque reference to an infrastructure-governed policy; this contract does not prescribe shared or dedicated topology.
